label: Permission mode CONFIRMED dropped: payloads carry permission_mode but the record has no field, arm copies only model/provider/effort (relaunch-core.cjs:1011) and Claude Stop calls arm with no settings (stop-arm.mjs:152).
Report :9 REFUTED in part: the record also carries name, hops and (Pi) provider, and holds only a goalSwitch boolean, not the goal; the goal packet travels in the note.
Pi flags replay from launch only (CONFIRMED), but --approve is a trust flag per pi --help, not a mode; --plan/--build are extension flags; live plan-mode readability UNCONFIRMED.
Added directories CONFIRMED launch-only; report missed that codex and cursor --add-dir are also replayed (skilled-loop:511, :516).
Claude Stop fixture carries session_crons (payload-stop.json:12) which stop-arm ignores; the report's adapter grep missed it.

Crons and self-paced wakeups end with the session (official doc: Tasks are session-scoped; restored only on --resume/--continue, self-paced /loop never); a hop denies --resume (skilled-loop:575), so they are lost. CONFIRMED.
Todo-list persistence UNCONFIRMED: no todos directory under ~/.claude; needs Claude docs on todo/task persistence or a relaunch test.

Per-runtime launch flags: claude --permission-mode and --add-dir; codex -s/-a and --add-dir; cursor --mode plan, --plan, --yolo, --add-dir; devin --permission-mode; opencode root --auto only; pi --plan/--build via extension. Only Claude can replay a stamped mode via an arm.
None of the report's nine changes is shipped; README documents change 7 as a known limit (:124), change 9 as scope (:32), and an operator-prompt withdraw that mitigates change 4 (:126).
README:83 says name comes from the relaunch record; the wrapper reads name from SKILLED_LOOP_NAME, not consume. Doc contradicts code.

Nine wrong or weak citations across the report collected (README:130 3s figure, guard scope, codex/shared.mjs:55, markOrphanedLineages location, record contents, --approve label, add-dir incomplete, missed session_crons, wrapper help-list comment).
